case: Reuse three lazy local field-name sets during data decoding
problem: A decoder repeatedly invoked immutable set construction for the same row fields and two coverage variants while checking a sequence of entries.
change: Keep three method-local set references, initialized lazily at their first original use. The common row set is created only when the first row is reached; each variant set is created only when its branch is first selected. Later entries reuse those fixed field names, while every original row and variant check still executes.
preserved_contract: Empty input and unvisited variants do not trigger eager set construction.
Only immutable constant field names are reused within one decoder call. Decoded data, numeric objects, references and validation results are not cached.
All parser and encoder invocations remain. No parse or encoding step is removed.
Closed field shapes, variant selection, number-before-reference order, row order and original data constructors remain.
Non-null provenance still requires its actual original-manifest replay. Public caller-supplied numeric data still reaches the original first state encoder.
No new public API, method, type or field is introduced.

software_evidence.origin: Owner implementation with independent source review and five new public DATA tests; test review was nonblind to the candidate.
software_evidence.timing_scope: Sum of three recorded process durations; not active effort, end-to-end workflow time or a speed measurement.
coverage: Repeated mixed coverage preserves literal order and roles.
Public foreign numeric data still reaches the first state encode boundary.
Unknown fields and unknown coverage variants preserve the original first failure.
Non-null provenance requires actual manifest replay.
Empty history and coverage decode as complete public data.

stderr.meaning: Logging-manager initialization diagnostic retained despite exit0 and five passing tests.

source_publication.test_editorial_adjustment: A comment-only publication edit preserved executable test tokens.

proof_boundary: These tests establish public DATA behavior. The foreign numeric case targets the first encoder boundary; malformed cases target the first row, not later reused-set failures. Successful non-null manifest replay and live-system authorization are not established. Fewer set-construction expressions do not measure heap allocation, JIT behavior or runtime speed.
